teacher_policy.acceptance: Local minimum must improve >1e-5; global minimum may not worsen >1e-5; global maximum<=1.06; overloaded line and transformer counts may not increase.
teacher_policy.score: (local UV count decreases [Boolean], local minimum improvement, -Q). This is not Reflection global UV-count ordering.

coordinator_candidate_limit.meaning: A local improvement is already recorded, but its global acceptance failed. These are unapproved proposals, never safe winners or replacement positive reward labels.
